'''Fudbalski klub Zvijezda 09''' ([[Serbian Cyrillic]]: ''Фудбалски клуб Звијезда 09'') is a professional [[association football]] club based in [[Ugljevik]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]].

Zvijezda 09 currently plays in the [[First League of the Republika Srpska]]. The club plays its home matches at the [[Ugljevik City Stadium]], which has a capacity of 5,000 seats.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://us.soccerway.com/teams/bosnia-herzegovina/zvijezda-09-brgule/34459/|title=ZVIJEZDA '09 BRGULE ETNO SELO STANIŠIĆ|access-date=9 June 2018|language=en|website=Soccerway|publisher=Perform Group}}</ref>"}}
